title: SymKL: A Unified Representation-Space Measure of Signal Degradation
abstract: arXiv:2610.39403v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantifying degradation between a pristine signal and its degraded observation is fundamental to signal processing, yet existing full-reference measures are inherently modality-specific. We introduce SymKL, a unified full-reference degradation measure based on implicit neural representations (INRs). An INR is fitted once to the pristine reference and characterized by its diagonal Fisher information, which captures the local information geometry of the learned representation. Evaluating the Fisher information with the pristine reference and a degraded observation yields two parameter-sensitivity profiles whose symmetric KL divergence defines the degradation score. The proposed formulation requires only the reference and degraded observation, without knowledge of the corruption process or degradation severity, making it applicable across images, audio, and 3D data. We further derive an exact closed-form expression for the diagonal Fisher

translated_title: SymKL：一种统一的表示空间信号退化度量方法
translated_abstract: 量化原始信号与其退化观测之间的退化程度是信号处理领域的基础问题，然而现有的全参考度量方法本质上都是针对特定模态的。我们提出了SymKL，一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的统一全参考退化度量方法。该方法首先将INR一次性拟合到原始参考信号，并通过其对角Fisher信息进行表征，该信息捕捉了所学表示的局部信息几何特性。分别用原始参考信号和退化观测来评估Fisher信息，可得到两个参数敏感度分布，它们的对称KL散度即定义了退化分数。所提出的公式仅需要参考信号和退化观测，无需了解退化过程或退化严重程度，因此可广泛应用于图像、音频和3D数据。我们进一步推导出了对角Fisher信息的精确闭式表达式。
tldr: 本文提出SymKL，一种基于隐式神经表示Fisher信息几何的统一信号退化度量方法，仅凭参考信号与退化观测、无需知晓退化过程，即可跨图像、音频和3D数据量化退化程度。
en_tdlr: SymKL is a unified full-reference degradation measure based on the Fisher information geometry of implicit neural representations, quantifying signal degradation across images, audio, and 3D data using only the reference and degraded observation, without requiring knowledge of the corruption process.
